Name: Shader Cache - DLL Path
Description: Specifies the DLL path used for shader disk cache association.

Name: Performance Counters - DX9 Export Only
Description: Limits driver performance counter export to DirectX 9 workloads.

Name: Shader Compiler - Offline Compile
Description: Controls whether the driver may use the offline shader compiler path.

Name: iCafe - Logo Configuration
Description: Controls driver-side iCafe logo presentation behavior.

Name: Battery Boost - Application FPS Limit
Description: Sets the Battery Boost frame-rate limit for the application.

Name: Power Management - External Quiet Mode
Description: Controls the external quiet-mode power policy.

Name: CUDA - Excluded GPUs
Description: Lists universal GPU identifiers that should be excluded from CUDA device selection.

Name: NVIDIA Image Scaling - Quality Upscaling
Description: Controls NVIDIA Image Scaling quality upscaling.

Name: Application Profile - Notification Timeout
Description: Selects how long application profile notifications remain visible.

Name: Antialiasing - SLI AA
Description: Controls SLI antialiasing mode selection.

Name: Idle Application - Dynamic FPS Limit
Description: Sets the dynamic frame-rate limit used when an application is considered idle.

Name: Idle Application - Threshold Time
Description: Sets the time threshold in seconds before idle-application frame-rate limiting is applied.

Name: Performance Counters - Export
Description: Controls whether driver performance counters are exported.

Name: Variable Refresh Rate - Overlay Indicator
Description: Controls the on-screen indicator for variable refresh rate activity.

Name: Latency Indicator - Auto Align
Description: Controls automatic alignment for the latency flash indicator.

Name: GPU Power - Maximum Limit
Description: Defines the maximum GPU power value exposed to Direct3D and OpenGL driver paths.

Name: Optimus - Compatibility Flags
Description: Controls Optimus compatibility and application GPU-selection behavior.

Name: Optimus - Maximum Resolution
Description: Limits the maximum resolution allowed for Optimus application handling.

Name: Optimus - Maximum Antialiasing Level
Description: Limits the maximum antialiasing level allowed for Optimus application handling.

Name: Stereo - Swap Eyes
Description: Controls eye-order exchange for workstation stereo output.

Name: OpenGL - Telemetry Monitor Level
Description: Selects the OpenGL telemetry monitor verbosity level.

Name: OpenGL - Force Stereo
Description: Controls forced OpenGL stereo rendering.

Name: OpenGL - Default Swap Interval
Description: Selects the default OpenGL swap interval and force policy.

Name: OpenGL - Default Swap Interval Fraction
Description: Selects the fractional scanline component for the OpenGL default swap interval.

Name: OpenGL - Default Swap Interval Sign
Description: Selects whether the OpenGL default swap interval fraction is applied as a positive or negative offset.

Name: OpenGL - GDI Compatibility
Description: Selects OpenGL GDI compatibility preference.

Name: OpenGL - Texture Filtering Quality
Description: Selects the OpenGL quality/performance bias for texture filtering and related quality enhancements.

Name: OpenGL - Maximum Frames Allowed
Description: Limits the number of OpenGL frames the driver may queue ahead.

Name: OpenGL SLI - GPU Multicast
Description: Controls availability of the OpenGL GPU multicast path for SLI and Mosaic configurations.

Name: OpenGL - Deep Color Scanout
Description: Controls OpenGL deep-color scanout support.

Name: OpenGL - Event Log Severity Threshold
Description: Selects the minimum OpenGL event severity written to the driver event log.

Name: OpenGL - Implicit GPU Affinity
Description: Controls implicit GPU affinity behavior for OpenGL contexts.

Name: SLI - Visual Indicator
Description: Controls the on-screen SLI split-frame rendering indicator.

Name: SLI - Rendering Mode
Description: Selects the active SLI rendering distribution mode.

Name: Steam - Application ID
Description: Stores the Steam application identifier used for driver profile association.

Name: VAB - Default Data
Description: Selects the default vertex attribute buffer data pattern used when API defaults are requested.

Name: Variable Refresh Rate - Control
Description: Controls whether the variable refresh rate path is enabled.

Name: Virtual Reality - Pre-Rendered Frames
Description: Sets the maximum number of frames the CPU may queue ahead for virtual reality rendering.

Name: Write TO Host Staging Buffer Size
Description: Set size of write staging buffer. If key is set to zero it will be ignored
